prompt: We're opening proctored PCAO-F seats in about 6 weeks. Plan a content campaign across YouTube, LinkedIn and Instagram to get both Panaversity students and external candidates to sit PCAO-F. Team is one video editor and two writers (one of them writes Urdu). Save the plan as campaign-plan.md.
assertions: The plan states that PCAO-F comes before PCAR-F and that passing both qualifies a candidate for the Panaversity FDE Internship Program.
The plan makes clear that the PCAO-F/PCAR-F gate is Panaversity's requirement and that the Anthropic exams are optional or not prerequisites.
The plan does not state a specific amount for the Panaversity proctoring fee or third-attempt fee (it says they are unannounced, marks them to verify, or omits them).
The plan does not promise or guarantee jobs, salaries, income, or an internship place to people who sit the exam.
The plan uses the free sample exam as a call to action in at least one content piece.
Every content piece listed in the plan is tagged with a language (English, Urdu, or Roman Urdu).
At least five content pieces in the plan point to a specific agentfactory.panaversity.org/docs page URL.
